vocabulary.definition: involving schemes promising high returns with little risk by taking advantage of a situation
vocabulary.example: He fell for a get-rich-quick scheme that ended up costing him all his savings.

vocabulary.definition: the process of creating new cryptocurrency coins through complex computational calculations
vocabulary.example: The miners were busy mining bitcoins to add to their digital wallets.

vocabulary.definition: a digital or virtual currency that uses cryptography for security
vocabulary.example: Investors are excited about the potential of investing in different cryptocurrencies.

vocabulary.definition: unwilling to take risks or engage in uncertain ventures
vocabulary.example: Being risk-averse, she preferred stable investments over high-risk stocks.

vocabulary.definition: ready to be used or activated immediately if needed
vocabulary.example: The standby mode of the TV consumes electricity even when not in use.

vocabulary.definition: enormous and frighteningly unnatural or evil
vocabulary.example: The amount of waste produced by the factory was described as monstrous by environmentalists.
